title: Design System: Shinme Japanese Language Center

shadows.name: lifted-focus
shadows.purpose: Modals, floating bars, and hover highlights

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Organic leaf-pop and panel slide-in transitions

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard call-to-action button in deep forest green
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #135E36; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0F4C2B; }

narrative.overview: Shinme's visual identity embodies growth, warmth, and steady progress in Japanese language mastery. Soft warm cream background, deep forest green authority, and sprout green progress highlights.

rules.name: The Sprout Rarity Rule
rules.body: Sprout green (#6CC24A) is an accent of growth, reserved for badges and progress bars.

rules.name: The Furigana Room Rule
rules.body: Japanese text with furigana must have minimum 1.8x line-height to avoid overlapping.

dos: Do always use <FuriganaText /> for Japanese kanji with readings.
Do maintain bilingual typography respect (Noto Sans JP + Nunito).
donts: Don't use cold gray #808080; use tinted sage #56685D.
Don't truncate Japanese words with awkward line breaks.
